desc:
Samurai combat game

It's time to study the blade

PC Controls:
M1 - Light Attack
M2 - Parry
Skill/Critical - G
Kick - Q
Dash - Space

Console Controls:
M1 - X
Parry - L2
Skill/Critical - Y
Kick - B
Dash - A
Draw / Sheathe - L1
Lock On - L3
Emotes - R1
Menu - View Button (or D-Pad Up)
Hotbar - D-Pad Down
Back / Close - B
